newsitem.title: USA: Pa. economic activity index rose 0.2 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Pa. economic activity index rose 0.2 pct in Feb.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Wednesday its Economic Activity Index for Pennsylvania rose 0.2 percent in February.
The rise was the result of a substantial increase in payroll employment, the bank said.
The state's unemployment rate, however, was up slightly and average hours worked declined.
For the 12 months ending in February, Pennsylvania's EAI was up 3.6 percent.
The national Index of Coincident Indicators compiled by the Conference Board rose 0.4 percent in February and was up 3.3 percent over the last 12 months.
The Economic Activity Index for Pennsylvania is constructed from three monthly data series -- payroll employment, average hours worked in manufacturing, and the unemployment rate.
